# cron

Types from PocketBase's Go package `cron`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [cron](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/cron).

## cron.Cron

Cron is a crontab-like struct for tasks/jobs scheduling.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `setInterval()` | <code>(d: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timeduration">time.Duration</a>): void</code> | SetInterval changes the current cron tick interval (it usually should be >= 1 minute). |
| `setTimezone()` | <code>(l: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timelocation">time.Location</a>): void</code> | SetTimezone changes the current cron tick timezone. |
| `mustAdd()` | <code>(jobId: string, cronExpr: string, run: () =&gt; void): void</code> | MustAdd is similar to Add() but panic on failure. |
| `add()` | <code>(jobId: string, cronExpr: string, fn: () =&gt; void): void</code> | Add registers a single cron job. |
| `remove()` | <code>(jobId: string): void</code> | Remove removes a single cron job by its id. |
| `removeAll()` | <code>(): void</code> | RemoveAll removes all registered cron jobs. |
| `total()` | <code>(): number</code> | Total returns the current total number of registered cron jobs. |
| `jobs()` | <code>(): Array&lt;(<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/cron#cronjob">Job</a> &#124; undefined)&gt;</code> | Jobs returns a shallow copy of the currently registered cron jobs. |
| `stop()` | <code>(): void</code> | Stop stops the current cron ticker (if not already). |
| `start()` | <code>(): void</code> | Start starts the cron ticker. |
| `hasStarted()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | HasStarted checks whether the current Cron ticker has been started. |

## cron.Job

Job defines a single registered cron job.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id()` | <code>(): string</code> | Id returns the cron job id. |
| `expression()` | <code>(): string</code> | Expression returns the plain cron job schedule expression. |
| `run()` | <code>(): void</code> | Run runs the cron job function. |
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalJSON implements `json.marshaler` and export the current jobs data into valid JSON. |
